css_files.purpose: Normalizes default browser styles by stripping out inconsistent margins, paddings, and default sizing behavior across different browsers.
Stores global design tokens using CSS custom properties, such as color palettes, typography, spacing scales, and dark mode theme definitions.
Defines structural layout systems using Flexbox and Grid, including container wrappers, grid systems, headers, and footers.
Contains modular, reusable styles for specific UI elements such as buttons, cards, modals, and input fields.
Provides high-specificity, single-purpose helper classes for quick spacing, text alignment, display toggles, and accessibility utilities.
